name: RS ENCODER MIRROR BOT
description: Telegram mirror, leech and FFmpeg video encoder bot with a built-in status page.

OWNER_ID.description: Your numeric Telegram user ID (get it from @userinfobot).

AUTHORIZED_CHATS.description: Group or user IDs allowed to use the bot, separated by spaces. Leave empty to allow only the owner.

SUDO_USERS.description: Extra admin user IDs, separated by spaces.

TMDB_API_KEY.description: Optional TMDb API key for automatic artwork thumbnails.

YT_COOKIES.description: Optional yt-dlp cookies in Netscape format (the file content, pasted as text).

MAX_CONCURRENT_TASKS.description: Tasks running at the same time. Keep 1 on small dynos.

MAX_PARALLEL_FFMPEG.description: Parallel FFmpeg processes. Keep 1 on small dynos.
